## Assignment Simulated Data

### 1. Load Cytokine Dataset

```{r Load Cytokine Dataset}
olink_inflammation_cytokines_1000 = read.csv("olink_inflammation_cytokines_1000.csv")
```

### 2. Simulate values for HD and Disease

```{r Simulation code}

set.seed(1)

# Defining dataset
n = 30      # Sample size
ng = 2      # Number of groups
p = 1000    # Number of variables

r = rnorm(n*ng*p, mean = 4, sd =2)

# Putting data into a matrix
data = matrix(r, p, n*ng)
data

# Add column and row names to df
colnames(data) = c(paste("HD", 1:n, sep=""), paste("Disease", 1:n, sep=""))
rownames(data) = c(paste(olink_inflammation_cytokines_1000$Assay, 1:p, sep=""))
data

colnames(data) = c(paste("HD", 1:n, sep=""), paste("Disease", 1:n, sep=""))
rownames(data) = paste(olink_inflammation_cytokines_1000$Assay, 1:p, sep="")

hd_cols  = 1:n
dis_cols = (n + 1):(n * ng)
```

### 3. Introduce outliers and errors

#### Increase SD for all Disease and select a certain groups of cytokines to have higher normalized values

```{r Increase SD and values in Disease}
set.seed(2)                                   # separate seed for the manipulation
cat_vec = olink_inflammation_cytokines_1000$Category

# Mean NPX increase in Disease per category (categories not listed stay at 0)
cat_shift = c("Chemokine"          = 2.0,
              "Interleukin"        = 1.5,
              "Acute phase/innate" = 2.5,
              "TNF superfamily"    = 1.0)

delta = cat_shift[cat_vec]                    # NA for unlisted categories
delta[is.na(delta)] = 0
delta = as.numeric(delta)

# Protein-to-protein variability around the category shift
up = delta > 0
delta[up] = delta[up] + rnorm(sum(up), mean = 0, sd = 0.3)


# Apply shift + inflate SD in the Disease group

sd_mult = 1.5                    # SD inflation for all Disease values

dis      = data[, dis_cols]
dis_mean = rowMeans(dis)         # each protein's own disease mean

# Scale deviations around the protein mean (means stay put), then add the shift
dis = dis_mean + (dis - dis_mean) * sd_mult + delta
data[, dis_cols] = dis

# Ground truth for validation
truth = data.frame(Protein   = rownames(data),
                   Category  = cat_vec,
                   TrueDelta = delta,
                   Up        = up)

```

## 4. Introduce biomarkers and errors

```{r}
# =====================================================
# 2. INTRODUCE BIOMARKERS AND ERRORS
# =====================================================

# 2.1 True diagnosis
group = c(rep("HD", n), rep("Disease", n))

# Columns corresponding to Disease patients
D_cols = which(group == "Disease")

# 2.2 Introduce 10 biomarkers
n_bio = 10

# Randomly select 10 proteins
biomarkers = sample(1:p, n_bio)

# Effects in Disease group
fc = c(4, 3, 3, 2, 2, -4, -3, -3, -2, -2)

for (k in 1:n_bio) {
  data[biomarkers[k], D_cols] =
    data[biomarkers[k], D_cols] + fc[k]
}

# Display selected biomarkers
biomarker_names = rownames(data)[biomarkers]
biomarker_names

# 2.3 Introduce one outlier patient
outlier = sample(which(group == "HD"), 1)

data[, outlier] = data[, outlier] + 3

# 2.4 Introduce one misdiagnosed patient
misdiag = sample(D_cols, 1)

group_obs = group
group_obs[misdiag] = "HD"

# Display the two problematic patients
colnames(data)[outlier]
colnames(data)[misdiag]
```

```{r}
data <- t(data)
tdata <- as.data.frame(tdata)
library(dplyr)

tdata <- tdata %>%
  mutate(DiseaseStatus = c(rep("Yes", 30), rep("No", 30)))
names(tdata)
```

### 6. ANONYMIZE AND EXPORT DATA

```{r}

# Randomize patient order
ord = sample(1:(n*ng))

# Create anonymous patient IDs
patient_id = paste("P", 1:(n*ng), sep="")

# Create final dataset
df = data.frame(
  patient_id = patient_id,
  group = group_obs[ord],
  t(data[, ord]),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Remove original row names (HD1, Disease1, etc.)
rownames(df) = NULL

# Export dataset to share
write.csv(df, "simulated_patients.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# =====================================================
# 4. SAVE GROUND TRUTH (DO NOT SHARE)
# =====================================================

# 4.1 Complete ground truth: all proteins and category effects
write.csv(
  truth,
  "simulation_ground_truth.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 4.2 Ground truth for the 10 specific biomarkers
truth_biomarkers = data.frame(
  protein = rownames(data)[biomarkers],
  fc = fc,
  direction = ifelse(fc > 0, "up in Disease", "down in Disease")
)

write.csv(
  truth_biomarkers,
  "simulation_ground_truth_biomarkers.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 4.3 Ground truth for atypical patients
atyp = data.frame(
  old_name = colnames(data)[c(outlier, misdiag)],
  new_id = patient_id[match(c(outlier, misdiag), ord)],
  type = c("outlier", "misdiagnosed")
)

write.csv(
  atyp,
  "simulation_ground_truth_patients.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
